decisions.statement: What is at work is asked of the seat's transcript rather than of the page index.
An index cannot answer for a page that is not in it, which is what is looked for.
A compacted transcript names no agent id and so names nothing as at work.
A transcript naming nothing at work is read as no evidence rather than as none.
A subagent whose launch the transcript has not folded yet is named by no agent id.
A subagent the transcript names by no agent id is counted rather than named.
A subagent dispatched a moment ago is at work with no page until one lands.
Nothing here writes a page, takes a page away, or reads a transcript itself.

definition: a subagent a seat's transcript names as at work with no page of its own
